business_problem: Baixin Bank wanted to build an internet-native intelligent bank from the cloud up, but it still had to solve the upfront cost, platform engineering, distributed transformation, automation, and data-governance challenges that come with running regulated financial workloads on a private cloud and microservices stack.
solution_summary: Baixin Bank worked with Baidu AI Cloud to build a private-cloud and distributed-services foundation that became the basis for its 'Baixin Financial Brain.' The implementation combined enterprise-grade distributed cloud architecture, microservice governance, and a bank-wide data strategy instead of treating cloud migration and AI as separate programs. Baixin set up a dedicated big-data organization to plan the bank's overall data architecture, govern data acquisition and quality, and turn data into decision support for marketing, product operations, and management. At the platform level, Baidu helped the bank establish private-cloud infrastructure and a governance framework capable of supporting faster internet-finance iteration, automation, and distributed business services. This gave Baixin a cloud-born operating model where product design, release, and operations all run on data. With stable cloud infrastructure underneath and a joint AI-finance laboratory on top, the bank created a practical route for making banking services more adaptive and intelligent without carrying legacy data-center baggage.

solution_components.name: Baixin Financial Brain
solution_components.role: Acts as the bank's intelligent service foundation by combining AI capabilities with cloud-native financial operations and data-driven decision support.

solution_components.name: Enterprise Distributed Cloud Architecture
solution_components.role: Provides the private-cloud infrastructure that underpins distributed financial systems and elastic business growth.

solution_components.name: Microservice Governance Framework
solution_components.role: Coordinates distributed business services, automation, and operational governance across the bank's cloud-native systems.

data_flow: Business-system data is delivered into Baixin's governed data architecture, the big-data team manages acquisition, quality, and model-building centrally, and the resulting insights feed marketing, product, operations, and customer-service decisions on top of the bank's private-cloud and microservice platform.
business_outcome: Baixin created a stable cloud-native banking base with strong operational resilience and a data-driven management model, giving it a practical path to smarter financial products and services.
architecture_clues: The bank was designed as a cloud-born institution rather than migrating legacy core systems gradually from the edge inward.
Data acquisition, model building, and data-quality control are centrally governed by the big-data team.
The stack combines private cloud, distributed architecture, microservices, and AI-finance laboratory work.
evidence_quotes: Baixin Bank and Baidu AI Cloud jointly built the 'Baixin Financial Brain' and one of the few full-cloud architectures in the banking industry. (original: 百信银行与百度智能云联合打造“百信金融大脑”，利用金融大脑对外提供智能化的服务，构建了全行业为数不多的全云架构。)

Baixin became a bank built on the cloud from the very beginning instead of a traditional institution dragging heavy historical baggage into cloud migration. (original: 以百信银行为代表的互联网银行...使得百信银行从一开始就能够成为一家建立在云上的银行。)

Baixin and Baidu jointly built big-data infrastructure, planned the bank's overall data architecture, and unified data acquisition, model building, and data-quality management. (original: 与百度智能云共同构建大数据平台的基础设施建设；另外，对百信银行全行数据架构整体规划和设计，对数据获取、模型建设、数据质量管控进行统一管理。)

Baidu and Baixin built private-cloud infrastructure and an enterprise-level distributed cloud architecture plus a microservice governance framework that passed regulatory acceptance. (original: 共同打造私有云基础设施，实现了企业级分布式云架构和微服务治理框架，并且顺利完成监管验收。)
All 39 business systems and 9 non-business systems have run stably since launch, with no level-5 incidents or security incidents. (original: 百信银行的39个业务系统和9个非业务系统自开业以来运行非常稳定，没有五级以上的运行事故，目前无一起安全事故。)
